title: Brier Score Trend by Quarter
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:resolution quarter=* brier_score=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats avg(brier_score) as metric by _time quarter
| sort 0 _time quarter
description: Trends monthly Brier score by quarter for resolved forecasts.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether resolved forecasts are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `quarter` on `forecast:resolution` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly Brier score.
visualization: Line chart of monthly Brier score by quarter.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how Brier score changes month by month for each quarter so you can see whether resolved forecasts are heading the right way.
